saw_lines: Home cooks search for one dinner idea tonight, judge it in seconds, then save it only if the recipe looks doable.
So the sale is won or lost in the first seconds, when a new visitor decides the recipe is worth saving.
Your 3 Google text ads should lead with your recipe count from the site description and one named dish, so the first line gives a reason to cook tonight.
